description: This file declares classes and methods for establishing SOCKS proxy connections, including parameters setup and connection job management, within the Chromium networking code.

classes.name: SOCKSSocketParams
classes.description: Holds parameters for creating a SOCKS socket, including proxy server info, destination, SOCKS version, and traffic annotation.

classes.name: SOCKSConnectJob
classes.description: Manages the process of connecting to a SOCKS proxy, including connection state, handling proxy authentication, and performing the SOCKS handshake.

methods.name: destination()
methods.description: Returns the destination host and port.

methods.name: is_socks_v5()
methods.description: Indicates if SOCKS v5 is used.

methods.name: GetLoadState()
methods.description: Returns current load state of the connection job.

methods.name: HasEstablishedConnection()
methods.description: Checks if connection has been established.

methods.name: HandshakeTimeoutForTesting()
methods.description: Returns the handshake timeout duration for testing.

methods.name: OnConnectJobComplete()
methods.description: Callback when a connect job completes.

methods.name: DoLoop()
methods.description: Runs the connection state machine loop.

methods.name: ConnectInternal()
methods.description: Starts the connection process, including transport and SOCKS handshake.

methods.name: ChangePriorityInternal()
methods.description: Adjusts the priority of the connection.
